name: SalesBuddy – Sales Pop Notifications
author: AcmeeDesign

sections.description:
WooCommerce Sales Notification is a powerful plugin designed to display recent or virtual order pop-ups on your website, creating a sense of urgency and trust among your visitors. By showcasing real-time purchase activity, this plugin enhances credibility and encourages potential customers to make a purchase. Increase your store’s conversion rate by building trust and creating FOMO (Fear of Missing Out) with WooCommerce Sales Notification!

Key Features

  • Display real-time or virtual sales notifications
  • Showcase On Sale products to highlight discounts and deals
  • Customize pop-up design, position, and timing
  • Show notifications site-wide or on specific pages
  • Randomized virtual order notifications for social proof
  • Mobile-friendly and lightweight for optimal performance
  • Easy-to-use settings with no coding required

Increase your store’s conversion rate by building trust and creating FOMO (Fear of Missing Out) with WooCommerce Sales Notification!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/your-plugin/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.changelog:

  • Used wp inline script function to include inline js.
  • Removed load_plugin_textdomain() as the plugin is hosted on WordPress.org is no longer needed to include.
